description.value: Hotel Belleclaire Central Park is a boutique hotel at 2175 Broadway on the Upper West Side, a short walk from Central Park. Guests get a complimentary wine hour Wednesday through Friday at its Allure bar. There is also live jazz on Friday evenings, a 24-hour gym, and a dog-friendly policy.
